provisional_until: calibrated against >=60 posts per (vertical, platform) cohort

1.1.0: RENAMED aws.terms.creator_standing.source from 'c3_ace' to 'ace_creator_score'. 'c3' meant the C-cubed framework (Creator/Content/Campaign), but ADR-0005 later named the Calibration Monitor 'C3'. The old value read as 'this AWS term is sourced from Component 3', which would be a boundary violation: C3 writes only a breaker flag and a library verdict, and C2 has no read path to it beyond Contract C. Naming only; no weight, gate, threshold, or behaviour changed.
ADDED scoring_inputs_forbidden. Records, machine-readably, that no trend signal and no mechanism enters VPS or AWS at any weight (ADR-0004, ADR-0006).

degradation.effect: flag audio_dependent criteria degraded=true; widen composite confidence band

terms.definition: percentile rank within campaign cohort of (post_er_24h / creator.median_er_24h)
terms.on_undefined: redistribute weight to cohort_percentile; flag insufficient_baseline

terms.definition: percentile rank of raw post_er_24h within campaign cohort

terms.on_zeroed: redistribute weight to outperformance_percentile and cohort_percentile

terms.source_note: The C-cubed framework's ACE (creator) score. NOT Component 3. C2 has no read path into C3 beyond Contract C.

statistics.rationale: engagement rates are heavy-tailed; means are dragged by prior viral posts
statistics.organic_boosted: recorded as separate series, never summed

exploit.method: proportional to (aws - aws_floor) over top-n eligible

budget_allocation.rounding: platform minimum spend increment; residual to top exploit candidate

provenance_rules: every vps and aws value is labelled Estimated
a Proxy value is never displayed, aggregated, or compared as Measured
every metric carries an as_of date

may_never: assign or promote a mechanism warrant

scoring_inputs_forbidden.description: Inputs that may never enter VPS or AWS at any weight, under any configuration. Enforced in application code, not by convention.
scoring_inputs_forbidden.trend_signal: ADR-0004. A scorer whose inputs change nightly cannot be evaluated on a temporally held-out split. Trend adherence enters BAS only as a deterministic check against a format named in the brief's stored text.
scoring_inputs_forbidden.mechanism: ADR-0006. A Mechanism's evidence is Proxy-SELECTED (ADR-0001, Tier 3) and it carries no calibrated prediction. Retrieving one into a score would launder Proxy provenance into a number a client sees, and would break the reproducibility of a VPS from its pinned (extractor x rubric x pattern_library) triple.
scoring_inputs_forbidden.mechanism_statement: Model-drafted prose. Untrusted as an input to any computation, exactly as a creator caption is.
